description: Six channels that each attenuate an input, optionally invert it, and add a DC offset of either sign; with nothing patched a channel is a bare voltage source

params.text: Attenuates that channel's input, from silence at fully counter-clockwise to unchanged at fully clockwise
Sets the DC voltage added to that channel after the level control, 0V to 10V
Switched to - that channel's input is inverted before the level control
Switched to - that channel's DC offset is subtracted instead of added, giving 0V down to -10V

inputs.text: The signal that channel attenuates; leave it unpatched and the channel takes whatever reached the input above it

outputs.text: That channel's input scaled by its LEVEL knob with its OFFSET added, clipped at ±10V unless the menu turns that off

notes: the six inputs cascade: a channel with nothing patched reads the channel above it, and channel 1 with nothing patched reads 0V. Patch one input and every channel below it follows.
with no input patched anywhere, each channel is a DC source putting out its OFFSET knob alone.
menu: Clip Output ±10V — holds every output inside ±10V; on by default, and turning it off lets a channel run past the rails
